name: The Love Potion
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Oh, the pains of love!  My dear Private Rocknot is immune to my charms.  I am spurned!  It's maddening!

You must help me!  We succubi know much of love, and I can make a potion to beat down the iron walls around Rocknot's heart.  To make it, I need these items: the herb gromsblood, giant silver veins from the cliff giants of Azshara, and water from the Golakka Springs Crater in Un'Goro.  You can place the water in this vial.

Please, adventurer, help a poor soul in her quest for happiness!
narrative.objectives: Bring 4 Gromsblood, 10 Giant Silver Veins and Nagmara's Filled Vial to Mistress Nagmara in Blackrock Depths.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Oh, you've done it!  I can now make my potion and use it on Rocknot.  Finally, he will fall victim to my charms!

Thank you, adventurer.  You are a champion of love!
narrative.requestItemsText: Do you have the ingredients?  The hole in my heart threatens to consume me!
